description: Answers a free-form question about a company report. Every factual claim is followed by a [Source: chunk N, page P] citation pointing back to the retrieved context. Generic QA primitive used by other skills and CLI callers.

input_variables.name: input
input_variables.description: Structured context from RetrievalPlugin (list of [Chunk N | Page P | score S] blocks separated by ---).

input_variables.name: question
input_variables.description: The user's question. Filled in by the caller; not auto-retrieved.
